pages.text: Each additional soul armor piece increases the chestplate's $(thing)maximum soul capacity$() and grants a unique bonus during $(thing)Soul Rage$().$(br2)All soul armor pieces have infinite durability and cannot be enchanted.

pages.title: Soul Helmet
pages.text: Grants $(thing)night vision$() during Soul Rage. The effect lingers for a time after Soul Rage ends.

pages.title: Soul Leggings
pages.text: $(thing)Doubles your movement speed$() during Soul Rage. You will also be able to walk up single-block ledges without jumping, like riding a horse.

pages.title: Soul Boots
pages.text: Grants $(thing)fall damage immunity$() during Soul Rage. Landing from a sufficient height will also deal damage to nearby mobs.
